name: Avoidance
overview: Scripture instructs believers to actively avoid those who cause division and promote false teachings, as seen in Romans 16:17 and Titus 3:10, emphasizing the importance of guarding the purity of doctrine. This avoidance is not rooted in fear but in a transformed mind and heart, renewed by God's truth, enabling believers to discern and follow His perfect will (Romans 12:2). Christ offers peace that overcomes fear and trouble, encouraging believers to trust in Him rather than conform to worldly patterns (John 14:27). Ultimately, God's love through Jesus Christ provides the foundation for living in truth and avoiding spiritual harm (John 3:16).
